note: 12 claims, 2 confirmed, 8 corrected, 2 unverified. Headline: Ramp's docs settle the partner question, since apps acting for other businesses must use Authorization Code and go through Ramp's Partner Integrations review, and 'Approval is required before production access'.

rows.claim: Who can create a developer app
rows.composio: Needs Owner or Admin access to the Developer section.
rows.ours: A Ramp admin creates the app under Company → Developer.
rows.provider: "In your Ramp account, go to Company → Developer (you'll need admin access)."

rows.composio: Click Create new app, name it, and agree to the Developer Terms of Service.
rows.ours: Click Create New App, name it, and accept the Terms.
rows.provider: "Click Create New App. Name your app ... and accept the Terms."

rows.claim: Grant types must be enabled on the app
rows.composio: Enable Authorization code, Client credentials and Refresh token.
rows.ours: Add Authorization Code and Refresh Token grants (inferred from a search snippet).
rows.provider: To use a refresh token, "first enable the Refresh Token grant type"; a grant that isn't enabled returns unauthorized_client.

rows.claim: Partner or production approval for multi-customer apps
rows.ours: Possibly needs partner enrollment (inferred from a third-party mirror).
rows.provider: Authorization Code is "required for third-party applications acting on behalf of other businesses"; partner integrations need Ramp approval before production access.

rows.composio: Add URIs in the app's Redirect URIs section, and they must match exactly.
rows.ours: Add a callback URL if the form asks for one (field not confirmed).
rows.provider: redirect_uri "must match exactly one of the URIs configured in your app"; HTTPS is required (localhost allowed for development).

rows.composio: Lists accounting, bills, cards, business, users, vendors and receipts scopes, plus offline_access.
rows.ours: Only transactions:read is named, and the full list was not read.
rows.provider: Scopes follow resource:permission (for example bills:write), plus openid and offline_access; cards:read_vault needs "additional security review".
Authorization Code tokens "default to 1 hour"; refreshing doesn't return a new refresh token or extend its expiry; codes last 10 minutes.

rows.composio: The Authorization URL differs between demo and production.
rows.ours: Unverified, and the probe of app.ramp.com/v1/authorize failed.
rows.provider: Uses https://demo.ramp.com/v1/authorize for sandbox and https://app.ramp.com/v1/authorize for production, with state required.

rows.composio: Demo and production accounts use different base and authorization URLs.
rows.ours: Sandbox access is requested from Ramp, with separate token URLs.
rows.provider: "Each environment requires separate app configurations"; tokens "work only in the environment where they were issued".

rows.claim: Who can approve the consent screen
rows.provider: Authorizing is "typically limited to Admin and Business Owner users"; anyone else gets "Business not authorized to use this application".
The OAuth guide doesn't mention PKCE; the changelog only adds optional code_challenge (S256) to the application OAuth handoff.

rows.claim: Email verification when creating an app
rows.composio: A 6-digit email code is required, valid for 5 minutes.
